name: whatsapp-bridge
description: Lets Claude keep you posted on WhatsApp — progress, problems, reports, questions — and lets you steer every session from your phone, through one self-hosted OpenWA number.

ownerNumbers.title: Owner number(s)
ownerNumbers.description: Your own WhatsApp number(s) with country code, comma-separated. Only these can command Claude, approve or answer. Also settable with /wa owner.

apiKey.title: OpenWA API key
apiKey.description: A SCOPED operator key (never the admin key). Optional here: /wa setup and the panel can store it, or export OPENWA_API_KEY.

allowedChats.title: Extra allowed chats
allowedChats.description: More chat ids the mod may use (e.g. 1203…@g.us), comma-separated. Your direct chat and linked project groups are always allowed; every other chat is ignored.

autoCreateGroup.title: Create a group per project
autoCreateGroup.description: Create "Claude · <project>" with only you in it on the first update (needs OpenWA's Baileys engine; otherwise link one with /wa link-project).

notifyMode.title: When to notify
notifyMode.description: away: only when you are away (no typing for the away minutes, or /wa away); always; off.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes without typing after which you count as away.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Hours when only critical messages go out, like 23-8 (empty: none).

interactionOffHours.title: Interaction off hours
interactionOffHours.description: Hours when Claude may not ask you anything (questions are parked), like 23-8. Overridden by the panel's On / Silent / Night.

digestMinutes.title: Digest every (minutes)
digestMinutes.description: How often info updates are batched into one digest (30-60).

maxPerHour.title: Messages per hour
maxPerHour.description: Cap on messages sent in an hour across all sessions; past it, updates wait for the digest.

pin.title: PIN for risky phone commands
pin.description: When set, STOP ALL and /slash commands from the phone must include it.

remoteApprovals.title: Approve permissions from the phone
remoteApprovals.description: While you are away and interaction is on, a permission prompt can be answered with 👍 / ❌ on WhatsApp.

longTurnMinutes.title: Long turn (minutes)
longTurnMinutes.description: Report a turn that finished after at least this long.

budgetSteps.title: Budget alerts (USD)
budgetSteps.description: Session cost thresholds that send an alert, comma-separated.

briefingTime.title: Morning briefing
briefingTime.description: Time of the morning briefing (HH:MM, empty: off).

eveningTime.title: Evening digest
eveningTime.description: Time of the evening digest (HH:MM, empty: off).

memberTrigger.title: Member trigger words
memberTrigger.description: Group members' messages starting with one of these (comma-separated) are questions for Claude; mentions and replies to the bot count too.

shareCodeWithMembers.title: Share code with members
shareCodeWithMembers.description: Let answers to group members include short code snippets.

ownerOnlyAlertsInGroup.title: Owner alerts in the group
ownerOnlyAlertsInGroup.description: Send cost, budget and approval alerts to the project group instead of your direct chat.

maxFileMb.title: File size cap (MB)
maxFileMb.description: Largest file send_file or a preview may send.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the polling session reads new messages while you are away (slower otherwise).
